prompt:
A single vertical Twitch channel "About" panel graphic, full bleed, for a fantasy MMO and anime RPG gaming channel. Look: premium game UI like a high-end modern anime action RPG or MMO menu, painterly and richly detailed, NOT flat vector. Mood: a cozy adventurers' guild tavern — warm, welcoming and lively, like "come in, sit down, we are about to start". Warm lantern and hearth light, polished dark wood, brass fittings, leather, maps. NOT gloomy, NOT gothic, NOT horror, no skulls, no darkness-heavy shadows. Frame: carved warm walnut wood with polished brass/gold corner fittings and small amber gems around the whole panel. Inside: a rich warm dark-brown wood or leather background (#2a1a10 to #1a100a) softly lit in amber, so light text stays very readable. Palette: honey gold (#f5c542), warm amber, candle orange, wine red accents, warm browns; a small touch of teal for contrast. Mature anime RPG art, not cute, not chibi, not cartoonish, not childish, no stickers. TYPOGRAPHY IS CRITICAL: render every text string EXACTLY as written below, in Spanish, letter by letter, with its accents, punctuation and the leading exclamation mark on commands. Crisp, perfectly legible, evenly spaced. Do not add, translate, abbreviate or invent any other text, numbers, logos or watermarks.

HEADER (only the top ~15% of the panel, a short wide strip): a painted scene of a tavern wall with a wanted/bounty board of monster trophies — a mounted dragon horn, a big battle axe, claw marks, warm lanterns; it blends softly into the panel. Any posters are blank or show only monster sketches, with no writing. Right under the header, centered: the title "JEFES DE RAID" in a large carved gold serif (Cinzel-like) with a soft warm glow, and under it a smaller cream line "Aparecen en el directo: ¡!atacar!". Then a two-column grid of 10 boss cards, 5 rows. Each card is a dark rounded tile with: on the left a small round painted portrait of the boss in a gold ring, glowing in its color; on the right the boss name in bold bright cream-white serif and under it its special attack in its color. Rows read left then right: Row 1: frost dragon (icy blue) "Dragón de Escarcha" / "Aliento helado" — skeleton king with crown (bone white) "Rey Esqueleto" / "Alza a los muertos". Row 2: swamp hydra (toxic green) "Hidra del Pantano" / "Mordisco venenoso" — obsidian golem with lava cracks (orange) "Gólem de Obsidiana" / "Terremoto". Row 3: hooded lich (violet) "Liche sin Nombre" / "Drenar alma" — giant spider queen (magenta) "Araña Reina" / "Telaraña". Row 4: kraken (sea teal) "Kraken del Foso" / "Tentáculo" — hungover minotaur looking queasy, a bit comic (sickly green) "Minotauro con Resaca" / "Vomitona". Row 5: a clumsy armored knight hiding behind a huge shield, a bit comic (steel blue) "Tanque que no sabe tanquear" / "Se pega solo" — a glitching pixel-noise specter with a broken wifi symbol (red) "Lag Primigenio" / "Desconexión". At the bottom, centered: "Cada uno tiene su ataque especial" with "ataque especial" in gold. TEXT SIZE: this panel is shown shrunk to 320 px wide, so text must be LARGE: boss names about 34 px tall, attacks about 30 px tall in this 1024 px wide image; names may wrap to two lines. Portraits are painted anime RPG monster art, mature, not cute.
